description: prune_policy_tree (lib.rs:1071) has two consecutive break conditions: 'if d == 0 { break; }' followed immediately by 'if prune_depth == 0 { break; }' where prune_depth = d - 1. The first check 'd == 0' is unreachable because d starts at cert_depth (always >=1 when this function is called meaningfully) and the second check catches the actual boundary case (d==1 → prune_depth==0). The d==0 guard is dead code. Remove the unreachable 'd == 0' guard to clarify the invariant.
title: pkix-path: prune_policy_tree loop has redundant break condition
